// About

A trainer who turns pressure into preparation.

Versatile training professional with a passion for building confident, career-ready students.

Over the last six years I've worked with institutions such as FACE Prep, Six Phrase / Veranda, and GITAM University, running interactive sessions in quantitative aptitude, reasoning, soft skills, and career readiness — so every batch walks into campus placements genuinely prepared.

Having also handled fresher hiring and quality assurance, I train to exactly what recruiters look for. Beyond India, I coach online Math for international learners.

// What I teach

Expertise built for the placement season.

Every module is designed backwards from the interview room — so students perform under real conditions.

01

Quantitative Aptitude

Numerical ability and data interpretation with speed techniques that hold up under timed tests.

02

Logical Reasoning

Pattern recognition, puzzles and analytical reasoning that sharpen problem-solving.

03

Verbal Ability

Grammar, comprehension and communication for written rounds and interviews.

04

Campus Recruitment Training

End-to-end CRT aligning aptitude, soft skills and interview practice.

05

Mock Interviews & Soft Skills

Realistic simulations that turn nervous freshers into composed candidates.

06

Online Math Coaching

Specialised Math instruction for international learners over Meet, Zoom & Teams.

// In the classroom

From covariance matrices to campus offers.

Earned an ‘A' grade in VIT's rigorous screening test and teaching demo, and trained students across some of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka's most recognised institutions.
